name: metavr_device
description:
Query and manage connected Meta Quest VR headsets via metavr (Meta's Quest dev CLI). DO NOT GUESS device state — your training data has no visibility into the user's hardware.

Read actions: list (START HERE to discover serials), info (target=<serial>), battery, controllers, proximity_get, boundary_get (Guardian state), wifi_adb_status, os (read-only OS/build info), vrruntime_get (VrRuntime debug overrides), wait (state=device|recovery|sideload|bootloader).

Mutating actions: connect (address=<ip:port>), disconnect (address optional — all when unset), wake, reboot (reversible), proximity_set (enable=true|false), boundary_set (enable=true|false — pause/restore Guardian for dev), wifi_adb_set (enable=true|false — one-tap ADB over WiFi), open_url (url=<http(s)://...>), vrruntime_set (pass a 'vrruntime' object of override fields), vrruntime_reset (restore VrRuntime defaults), network_impairment_set (pass a 'network_impairment' object — GK-gated, one-shot, auto-disables ~30s later). network_impairment_status reads the on-device VPN state (GK-gated).

Always call action='list' first when multiple headsets may be connected; pass `target` serial to other actions.

action.description:
Action to run. One of:
- list: list connected devices (no args)
- info: full info for a single device (target=<serial>)
- connect: connect over WiFi (address=<ip:port>)
- disconnect: disconnect from WiFi (address=<ip>, optional — disconnects all when unset)
- wake: wake device from sleep (target=<serial>, optional)
- reboot: reboot device (target=<serial>, optional; reversible mutation)
- wait: wait for ADB state (state=<device|recovery|sideload|bootloader>)
- battery: battery info (target=<serial>, optional)
- controllers: paired-controller info (target=<serial>, optional)
- proximity_get: current proximity sensor state (target=<serial>, optional)
- proximity_set: set proximity sensor (enable=true|false; target=<serial>, optional)
- boundary_get: current Guardian/boundary state (target=<serial>, optional)
- boundary_set: enable/disable the Guardian/boundary for dev (enable=true|false; target=<serial>, optional)
- wifi_adb_status: current ADB-over-WiFi state (target=<serial>, optional)
- wifi_adb_set: one-tap enable/disable ADB over WiFi (enable=true|false; target=<serial>, optional)
- open_url: open an http(s) URL in the headset browser (url=<http(s)://...>; target=<serial>, optional)
- os: read-only OS/build info (version, build, branch, lock state; target=<serial>, optional)
- get_property: read Quest Scriptable Testing (MQST) properties: disable_guardian/disable_dialogs/disable_autosleep/set_proximity_close (target=<serial>, optional). The mutating `set-property` command is CLI-only by design.
- vrruntime_get: read the current VrRuntime debug overrides (CPU/GPU level, foveation, ASW, color space, etc.; target=<serial>, optional)
- vrruntime_set: write VrRuntime debug overrides — pass a 'vrruntime' object with only the fields to change (target=<serial>, optional)
- vrruntime_reset: reset every VrRuntime override to its runtime default (target=<serial>, optional)
- network_impairment_status: read the on-device network-impairment VPN status (target=<serial>, optional; GK-gated)
- network_impairment_set: start/apply network impairment — pass a 'network_impairment' object with only the fields to change (target=<serial>, optional; GK-gated; one-shot, auto-disables ~30s later)

address.description: WiFi address (ip or ip:port). Required for action='connect'; optional for action='disconnect'.

enable.description: Boolean toggle for set actions. Required for action='proximity_set' (sensor on/off), action='boundary_set' (guardian on/off), and action='wifi_adb_set' (ADB-over-WiFi on/off).

anyOf.description:
Network-impairment parameters for `action='network_impairment_set'`. Every
field is optional; only the provided ones become flags. Mirrors the CLI's
`device network-impairment on` flags and the core `ImpairmentSettings` shape.

network_impairment.description: Network-impairment parameters for action='network_impairment_set'. Pass only the fields you want to change; the rest use MQDH defaults (bandwidth 100 Mbps, others 0). All values are integers. egress_* are device->network (uplink); ingress_* are network->device (downlink). This action applies a one-shot start with an initial heartbeat; the headset auto-disables impairment ~30s later, so sustained impairment needs the CLI `device network-impairment on --watch`.

state.description: ADB state to wait for. Required for action='wait'. One of: device, recovery, sideload, bootloader.

target.description: Device serial used to disambiguate when more than one device is connected. Optional for read actions; passed to metavr as the global `--device <serial>` flag.

url.description: The http(s) URL to open on the device. Required for action='open_url'.

anyOf.description:
VrRuntime override fields for `action='vrruntime_set'`. Every field is
optional; only the provided ones are written. Mirrors the CLI's
`device vrruntime set` flags and the core `VrRuntimeOverrides` shape.

vrruntime.description: VrRuntime overrides for action='vrruntime_set'. Pass only the fields you want to change; the rest of the runtime state is left untouched. Ranges (matching MQDH): cpu_level/gpu_level 0-5, foveation_level 0-4, asw_mode 0-3, swap_interval 0-3, layer_filter 0-4, layer_auto_filter 0-3. color_space is one of !Unmanaged, Rec.709, P3, Rec.2020, !Quest. The booleans (dynamic_foveation, gfr_mode, subsampled_layout, local_dimming, sysprop_debug) toggle the matching debug.oculus.* sysprop.

arguments.description:
Request parameters for `hzdb_device`.

Each `action` value maps to a fixed hzdb subcommand invocation under
`hzdb device <subcommand>`. See [`action_to_argv`] for the full mapping.
arguments.title: MetavrDeviceRequest
